links.outcome: Inflation of AUC from image-level random splitting versus patient-level splitting (leakage-free evaluation)
links.effect: On single-source drug-resistance probe, random image-level splitting inflated internal AUC by 1.7 points (95% CI 0.9 to 2.4; p=0.001), or 1.2 after dedup repair; holdout gap 1.1 shrank to 0.4 on patient-disjoint holdout. Multi-source effects <0.1 points.
links.quote: On a single-source probe task (drug resistance within TB Portals), random image-level splitting inflated the internal AUC by 1.7 percentage points (95% confidence interval 0.9 to 2.4; p = 0.001), or 1.2 points after a deduplication gap found during revision was repaired; in a holdout design, an internal gap of 1.1 points shrank to 0.4 points on a patient-disjoint holdout.
